principle_violations.reason: The pay method in the PaymentProcessor class handles the payment processing and also updates the order status. This method is doing more than one responsibility.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the responsibility of updating the order status into another method or an Order method to comply with the Single Responsibility Principle.
